name: When The Sea Received The Sky
source:
The world is fucked. The state disapproves of you cultivating the same plants it grows, and the body of your partner is ever crumbling under the weight of decay. Join Zero and Euphoria on this downward spiral against the world, along a path lined by cybernetic trees. Oh yea, the plants are the body parts.

[From [url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/when-the-sea-received-the-sky]itch.io[/url]]
